title: Gearbox ratios, indexing and final drive
inputs: Establish fitted tire rolling circumference and tachometer/speed reading method
Capture steady RPM and speed pairs in every forward gear and reverse
Record neutral and gear-index behavior plus shift timing
expected: Per-gear ratio estimates with trial spread
Final-drive estimate with stated tire circumference dependency
Verified index order, reverse and neutral behavior
toleranceNotes: Use at least five steady samples per gear. Do not validate ratios until tire circumference, instrument uncertainty and clutch slip are bounded.
